proposition.claim:
The chosen CTF1/CTF2 pair shares the observational law but has different counterfactuals; the higher CTF2 error suggests CausalNF learns CTF1.

One significant comparison among100realizations indicates realism checks rarely identify meaningfully lower ATE bias.

See the source claim and its conditions in the retained report.

repair.content:
Use a mathematically consistent noise/mechanism pair, disclose exact run configurations, and reevaluate the interpreted performance. Uniform U2 with U1 retaining both signs repairs CTF1/2 observational equality; additionally uniform U3 repairs corresponding CTF3/4 pair.

Define selection estimand; analyze disjoint groups with appropriate assumptions or resample complete seed/filter/error records; report effect sizes, uncertainty, practical threshold, acceptance rate and valid-test counts.

State precise mean-norm definition or recompute intended RMSE from per-unit predictions and update labels.
